posts.author: Mrhifi
posts.text: · Tror ikke vi skal ha positive forventninger til de 2 Petrobras tenders 🤔 Vilkårene for Petrobras 2 tenders, er ikke spesielt attraktive. Citat. 20 November 2026. Ceo, Reese McNeel: I want to give people a little bit more flavor on these Petrobras contracts, just as an insight. If I go onto a Petrobras contract, I need to actually take the rig off hire, I need to clean the hull, and I need to upgrade it for Petrobras' required new specification. As a sort of indicative figure, that cost, just for the upgrades alone, you are between $8 million and $10 million, and then you're talking about all the time that you are off hire. So, winning a Petrobras contract where you are off hire in March and only on hire in 2028 has a significant double-digit, $20 million-$30 million cash need, because you're not receiving income, you need to keep the vessel laid up, you need to clean the hull, and you need to do all of these Petrobras upgrades. Yes, you do receive a mob fee, but that will be far into 2028. Again, you are stuck on a contract for five years at this rate with no inflationary adjustment. I think, from our perspective, I think looking after the interests of the business, we have to outweigh that against the alternative of some of these other contracts where you don't have to do the upgrade work. There are contract opportunities starting earlier than the end of 2028. As well, you have to take into consideration that there is no good layup location for these size of vessels, whether it's ours, whether it's Floatel's, whether it's some of our competitors. No good layup location in Brazil. It's a very expensive endeavor to be in Brazil without a contract for a period of time. I think that is also one of the reflections about why we, in this tendering process, do not have a strong interest in chasing down parties, particularly if they're parties we don't know, or parties who we have actually seen being willing to go quite far down on price in recent tenders. Citat 2. I think you actually saw in this latest tender, there was only two participants, ourselves, one other party, and you did not actually see the likes of some of our competitors, longer, more established competitors bidding at all. I think that is a reflection of the process, the rate, and also people evaluating this, "Do I want to lock a vessel in for five years at this rate and on these terms, or do I prefer to see where the market goes?"

posts.author: AlphaTrade
posts.text: Det ble ikke nevnt noe om Surinam-tenderen i går fra Mcneel eller Q&A. Tildeling venter man fortsatt på med "oppstart tidlig i 27". Siden tideling ikke har skjedd regner jeg med oppstarten er forskyvet til Q2/Q3. Eurus/Zephyrus bør være aktuelle her. Varighet 1-1,5 år. Pareto nevner en potensiell Equinor-kontrakt til Eurus, og Mcneel nevner den samme med oppstart i Q3/Q4. Antagelig er dette det mest sannsynlige alternativet til riggen. Raten er sikkert over USD 140k/d.
